metadata.description: The ehos-app plugin alone, under a name of its own, for the applications ehos_app generates: Claude Code keeps one copy of a marketplace per name, and EHOS's own repositories pin the ehos-tools marketplace at another tag.

plugins.name: ehos-app
plugins.description: Skills for working on an application built on EHOS, which ehos_app's template enables in every project it generates: plan a change, ship it to a ready pull request, review a branch through the application's lenses (its contracts, credentials, ehos.yaml, migrations), and review Elixir for anti-patterns.
